articleTitle: Filtration of Stray Microwave Emissions from Magnetron Cathode Leg
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The work is devoted to reducing and filtration of stray microwave emissions from magnetron cathode leg using choke devices. A spectral analysis of microwave radiation from the M-177 magnetron operating at a frequency of 915 MHz with a traditional cathode leg design was performed. A new design of the choke device on the cathode leg of the magnetron has been developed and optimized Using numerical methods. The new design will allow additional filtering of the second harmonic of the fundamental frequency and increase the dielectric strength of the cathode assembly.

articleTitle: Design Features of a Portable Microwave Sterilizer for Wide Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The task of sterilizing instruments for various purposes (surgical, dental, cosmetology) is relevant due to their widespread use. Most sterilization methods take a long time (more than 1 hour) and are performed in large-sized installations.Sterilization devices that are currently used have large dimensions and complex technology for preparing instruments for the processing process. They are based on thermal principles, as a result of which the processing time in them is more than an hour. Their large size and weight do not allow them to be used as mobile sterilization units. The great advantage of the proposed sterilization method is the simplicity of the instrument processing process; it does not require additional preparation or consumables. Instruments are ready for use immediately after removing them from the sterilizer. These facts show the prospect of using a microwave sterilizer not only in hospitals, but also in mobile medical care units. This paper presents design documentation for a portable microwave sterilizer with a processing time of 10 minutes.The work provides design drawings of the sterilizer resonator chamber, an electrical circuit and a list of electronic components of the control and heating system for the microwave sterilizer.

articleTitle: Microwave Radiometry in Pulmonology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In the course of the work, mathematical modeling of the intrinsic radiation of the volume of biological tissues on the projection of the lungs was carried out. The purpose of the work was to evaluate the capabilities of microwave radiometry in examining the lungs. Microwave radiometry may have prospects for use as part of an integrated approach in the diagnosis and monitoring of treatment of lung diseases. The method also has high potential in the early diagnosis of pulmonary complications of COVID-19 as an alternative to computed tomography.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Electrodynamic Characteristics of a Double-Gap Capacitively Loaded Resonator for a Multibeam Klystron
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article examines the influence of the parameters of the multi-beam klystron resonator on its electrodynamic characteristics. A cavity resonator is considered with eight electrodes located on a disk in the center on a support rod along the perimeter of which conductive rods are located. The influence of changes in the diameter of the rods along the perimeter and the length of the support rod on the following parameters is shown: resonant frequency, Q-factor and characteristic resistance.

articleTitle: Klystron Double-Gap Resonator with Integration of CeSRR Elements into the Resonance System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the research of a metamaterial klystron resonator in the form of an electric-type complementary split-ring resonator are reported. The electrodynamic parameters of the resonator and the electric field vectors in the resonator gap have been calculated by the finite element method in the frequency domain. The results of the calculation of the electronic parameters are given. The resonator can be used in miniature multi-beam klystron-type devices for various telecommunication and communication systems.

articleTitle: On the Maximum Efficiency of Powerful Klystrons with a Limited Bunching Length
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The mechanisms of reducing the maximum possible efficiency of klystrons with a decrease in the interaction length and an increase in the beam perveance are considered. The results of optimization of a powerful klystron with a total length limited from above and with a beam perveance limited from below are presented.

articleTitle: Bipolarized S and L Band Radiometer for Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the development the new bipolarization S and L bands radiometer are presented. The features of the construction of the circuit and the general layout of the structural elements of the radiometer are shown. The radiometer microwave elements designs of the components are given. The main characteristics and design features of a bipolarized dual-band printed-type antenna of a radiometer are given. The use of small-sized band-pass microwave filters on surface acoustic waves is justified to reduce the microwave receivers dimensions and weight of the radiometer as a whole. It is shown that it is possible to use the new radiometer as a load on agricultural drones and use it to introduce technologies for remote sensing of soil moisture content and temperature into a precision farming use system to ensure sustainable development of agriculture, and in particular, crop production.

articleTitle: Recommendations on Designing Wire Grid Conical Horn Structures for Sparse Antenna Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of moments is widely used with wire grid to analyze and design different types of antennas. Researchers provided several recommendations on designing wire grid structures. However, these recommendations are not suitable for generating initial wire grid structures on which the optimal current grid approximation approach can be applied. These structures are required for generating sparse antenna structures with less mass. In this paper, new recommendations on generating initial wire grid structures of conical horn antennas are proposed. These new recommendations form a novel design guide that considers specific conical horn wire grid structures with different equivalent excitation models. The effectiveness of this design guide is verified by applying it to conical horn antennas operating in different frequency bands. The obtained antenna characteristics of the resulting wire grid structures are compared with those obtained experimentally and numerically using other methods. The compared results agreed well. The results of this paper can enable antenna designers to quickly and accurately design initial wire grid structures of conical horn antennas with acceptable characteristics for efficient sparse antenna generation.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Klystron-Type Sectorial Multi Channel Cavity with Walls Made of Short-Circuited Rods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article presents the results of three-dimensional electromagnetic modeling of a complex of electronic and electrodynamic parameters of a 54-channel three-sector klystron cavity. The parameters include the resonant frequency, the internal Q factor, the characteristic impedance, the interaction coefficient and the active component of the electronic conductivity. The walls of the cavity are designed as short-circuited rods, and a multipath klystron using such cavities could be used in microwave heating applications and other.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Operation of a Linear Image Sensor as Part of a Linear Displacement Measurement Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Currently, optical position-sensitive devices are increasingly being used to measure linear displacements. In this paper, a linear image sensor is considered as such a device. The main objective of the research is to develop algorithms that improve the accuracy of sensors of this class. The research was conducted using computer model methods. The movement of the light spot along the linear image sensor was simulated. The spot coordinate was determined by the centroid-method. Three criteria for the formation of a sample of signals for calculations are considered. The dependences of the measurement error of the spot coordinate on its displacement for each criterion are obtained.

articleTitle: Circuit Design Method for Reducing Static Current Consumption and Integrated Circuit Die Self-Heating in High-Temperature Transimpedance and Operational Amplifiers Based on Field-Effect Transistors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The circuit design method has been developed for halving the static current consumption of differential stages on field-effect transistors in transimpedance and operational amplifiers, which is recommended for use in micro-power analog microcircuits. An elementary thermal model of a high-temperature integrated circuit based on silicon-carbide (SiC), gallium-arsenide (GaAs) and silicon (Si) technologies under conditions of exposure to elevated temperatures is considered for the case when the integrated circuit die (chip) releases its self-power P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>. The permissible values of the self-heating power P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> have been determined for SiC, GaAs and Si technological processes that ensure the operation of the integrated circuit die at a temperature not higher than a given limit value.

Author Keywords: microcircuit with low self current consumption
self-heating of the integrated circuit die
design and technological features of high-temperature microcircuits

articleTitle: 3-D Particle-in-Cell Simulation of an Electromagnetic Wave Cyclotron Resonance Interaction with a Counterpropagating Electron Beam
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Interaction of a monochromatic electromagnetic wave with a counterpropagating, initially rectilinear electron beam under the cyclotron resonance condition is studied. The changes in the regimes of wave propagation with increasing frequency of the input signal are discussed. In the cyclotron absorption band, the input signal decays. As the signal frequency increases, the wave transmission becomes possible, and the signal splits into a train of traveling solitons. This phenomenon is due to the development of modulation instability (MI). At higher frequencies, the MI changes its character from absolute to convective, as a result of which non-stationary self-modulation regimes are replaced by stationary single-frequency signal propagation. The theoretical predictions are verified by 3-D particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation of the electron-wave interaction using the CST Studio Suite software package. 3-D PIC simulation has demonstrated the possibility of converting the 241.3-GHz continuous-wave signal into a periodic train of pulses with a duration of about 3–4 ns. Such a phenomenon is of interest for the generation of frequency combs in the microwave range.

articleTitle: Distribution of Electron Concentration of Gas Discharge Plasma in a Transverse Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work examines the influence of a magnetic field on the concentration of charge carriers in a flat gas-discharge plasma. The effect of a magnetic field on the movement and interaction of charged particles in plasma, as well as its influence on the formation and distribution of charge carrier concentrations, is studied. Numerical experiments with various magnetic field parameters and analysis of the obtained data were carried out. The results obtained allow us to better understand the physical processes occurring in gas-discharge plasma under the influence of a magnetic field, and can be useful for the development of new technologies and improvement of existing methods of using plasma.

articleTitle: MoM-Based Performance Analysis of Different Corner Reflector Scatterers Using Wire Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The investigation of characteristics and applications of different corner reflector types is a relevant task for modern technologies related to the field of electromagnetic wave scattering. In this paper the scattering characteristics of square and triangular trihedral corner reflectors as well as dihedral corner reflector structures are analyzed using equivalent wire grid models. These models are obtained using a developed MATLAB code based on the method of moments with pulse basis function. The performance of each structure is evaluated by comparing their characteristics with each other and their possible applications are provided and justified.

articleTitle: Hardware-Software Complex for Measuring the Thermal Resistance of Power Modules
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article shows the results of studies of the thermoelectric properties of power modules based on IGBT transistors are presented. It is shown that the properties of such modules can be described using a thermal impedance matrix that takes into account thermal connections between the transistors of the module. Measuring off-diagonal matrix elements using standard methods is problematic due to low accuracy. To solve the problem, it is proposed to use a modulation method for measuring thermal resistance, in which the module transistors are heated by variable thermal power. The method is implemented in a hardware and software complex designed to measure the thermal resistance of power modules with any type of transistors.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis of Injection Locking of a Gyrotron by an External Harmonic Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, synchronization of a gyrotron by an external harmonic signal is analyzed based on a simplified theoretical model. The main attention is paid to the case of gyrotron operating in the hard-excitation regime. Stability conditions of the synchronization regimes are analyzed when the beam current and cyclotron resonance mismatch are varied. The possibility of reaching maximum interaction efficiency in the synchronization mode is discussed.

articleTitle: Study of Energy Circulation Processes in Multilevel Voltage Inverter for Multifrequency Induction Heating of Metal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of energy flows studying in a universal multilevel inverter, when an output voltage with a complex and controlled harmonic composition of the curve is forming. It is intended for multifrequency induction heating of metal blocks containing of various sizes fragments. Energy processes in such inverter differ from those well studied in traditional two-level voltage inverters, which follows directly from the difference in the principles of the output voltage curve forming in these converters. The patterns studying of these processes in a universal multilevel inverter is the purpose of this article. The methodology for the goal achieving consists in identifying of the main energy flows between elements of its power circuit, development of their mathematical and computer models that allow studding of their flow patterns. The practical and scientific significance of results presented in the paper consists in their use to optimize the control system and justify the choice of elements parameters of the converter circuit for multifrequency metal heating equipment.

articleTitle: Ion Gate High Voltage Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper describes the results of the development of an ion gate high-voltage power supply. The schematic and design of the main components of the power supply are described. Thermal modes of operation of transistor switches included in the power supply are considered.

articleTitle: Determination of the Radiation Zone Based on a Radar Antenna Using a Computer System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the results of developing a computer system, the use of which allows increasing the efficiency of the process of adjusting the radar image zone. The proposed computer system allows adjusting to various characteristics of radars and rotary devices. This allows, based on a mathematical model of radar radiation, to calculate the values of the parameters of the radiation coverage zone for forming a radar image. A description of the functional structure of the computer system, the characteristics and structure of information support, an algorithm for solving the problem of adjusting a radar antenna to determine the radiation zone, and test results that confirmed its operability are given.

articleTitle: Focusing Properties of a Cylindrical Lens Formed by a Photonic Crystal Composed by Hollow Metal Cylinders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Two mathematical models, algorithms, and software have been developed to study the diffraction of an electromagnetic wave on a cylinder made of artificial magnetodielectric, which is a photonic crystal made of hollow metal cylinders. In the first model, based on the calculation of a 3d photonic crystal, equivalent anisotropic electric and magnetic constants were obtained and used. The near field of a cylindrical magnetodielectric lens with these parameters is investigated. In the second model, the problem of diffraction on a large (several thousand) number of metal cylinders is directly solved. This solution is applied to the calculation of a real cylindrical lens. Comparison of the results obtained by the two methods shows that the accuracy of the calculation of focusing devices made of photonic crystals on the basis of an approximate first model is sufficient for practice.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Research of Fractal Antennas Designed by SIW-Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper reports the results of the research of fractal antennas based on the Sierpinski carpet fractal using SIW technology. Modelling and simulation were carried out by the finite element method. Experimental prototypes of fractal antennas were fabricated and researched. The analysis of calculated data with experiment showed good agreement.

articleTitle: On the Design of Electron-Optical Systems of Microwave ED for the 220 GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the design of electron-optical systems for electro-vacuum O-type devices designed to operate in the 220 GHz band are presented. The fundamental necessity of taking into account the phase volume of the electron flow at all stages of designing an electron gun and magnetic focusing system is shown. An example is given of designing an EOS with a current of 0.15 A at a voltage of 22400 V in a unipolar magnetic field with an amplitude of 0.45 Gs.

Author Keywords: formation and transportation of electron flow

articleTitle: Broadband Transition Based on a Symmetrical Slot Line
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper considers a broadband transition model based on a symmetrical slot line, in the design of which a partially metallized hole is used. The finite element method was used to calculate and analyze the transition model characteristics. The results of the numerical calculation of the considered transition characteristics have been obtained.

articleTitle: Terahertz Plasma Annealing of Gallium Arsenide in a Microcavity Resonator Powered by a Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The combination of low specific intrinsic conductivity and nanosecond relaxation time of photoconductivity allows us to consider gallium arsenide (or GaAs) to be the most promising semiconductor in the terahertz frequency range. The known design of a nanosecond waveguide semiconductor switch contains a microcavity that makes it possible to achieve air-breakdown field values of ~25...30 kV/cm at a 400-millisecond pulse power of about 90 W from a gyrotron with a frequency of about 270 GHz. Extreme power densities of the order of 200 kW/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are safely created in a compact volume. A short-term appearance of plasma in the resonator is observed, leading to both an increase in its quality factor at low energies and a decrease in the quality factor at high energies. The change in quality factor is associated with effective cleaning or contamination of the surface of gallium arsenide by chemical elements in the air. There is an optimal irradiation regime that allows for effective, simple and relatively long-term annealing of gallium arsenide from the oxide layer, even without vacuum and additional chemicals. It is expected that the efficiency of semiconductor purification when using vacuum will increase, even to the point of replacing previously known methods.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of a Sheet–Beam W-band Traveling-Wave Tube with a Double-Grating Slow-Wave Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Development of miniature vacuum amplifiers and oscillators operating at millimeter and submillimeter frequency bands is one of the prior tasks of modern vacuum electronics. Traveling-wave tube (TWT) is a promising device since it can provide wideband gain and high output power. In this paper, the results of development of a miniature W-band TWT with a sheet electron beam and staggered double-grating slow wave structure (SWS) are presented. The results of simulation of high-frequency parameters of the SWS are presented. The SWS was designed to achieve synchronism with a 14–15 kV sheet electron beam. Simulation of beam-wave interaction predicts gain higher than 25 dB and output power up to 65 W at beam current of 0.1 A. The results of development of a vacuum window are also presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Sensitivity of the Annular Magnet Magnetic Field to Changes in Its Thickness for Magnetic Focusing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Reducing the geometric parameters of permanent magnets makes the electronic parameters of the traveling wave tubes especially sensitive to various technological deviations. Under such conditions, it is especially important to analyze the effect of changes in the geometric parameters of the magnets on the stability of the electron beam. A mathematical model of magnetic field sensitivity is presented. The obtained calculations were analyzed according to the model and the effectiveness of using magnetic field sensitivity analysis simultaneously with the magnetic parameter to assess the influence of technological deviations on the focusing of the electron beam was proven. The result of the work can be used in the design of traveling wave lamps at the stage of determining the geometric parameters of the device.

articleTitle: Reasons for Defects in Solder Paste Reflow in a Vapor Phase Soldering System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this article defects occurring at reflow of solder paste Sn62Pb36Ag2 in the system of vapor-phase furnace and methods of their elimination are considered. Special attention is paid to the temperature profile and methods of its adjustment. The principle of operation of the vapor phase furnace system and technological operations that are performed during the assembly of products are given.

articleTitle: Cooling Mechanisms for Power Supply Elements: Overview and Calculation Plan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article provides strategies for maintaining the optimal temperature of modern microwave amplifiers. The study is about a microwave module that has a semiconductor amplifier, a vacuum amplifier, and a power supply system combined together. An example is shown of how to look at the heat in a microwave and electronic module, and how to figure out the heat in an amplifier. This way will help you check if the cooling system works well.

articleTitle: A New Type of Cavities for a High-Power S-Band Multibeam Klystron with Output Power 30 MW
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A new type of multibeam toroidal cavities with helical inductive inserts in interaction gap is presented. On their basis the interaction region of high-power 37-beam klystron is the designed having eight-cavities including second-harmonics cavity. According to a one-dimensional model at current 19.8 A per beam and accelerating voltage 85 kV, the output power reaches 39 MW with an efficiency of 64.5 %.

articleTitle: Optical Properties of GaAs Porous Layers Fabricated on Wafers Pre-Irradiated with Gamma Radiation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, we an investigation of the characteristics of porous gallium arsenide layers fabricated GaAs substrates subjected to low-dose gamma irradiation. We selected gamma radiation doses during the processing of gallium arsenide wafers in the range of 10 to 200 kR. Porous GaAs layers are obtained by electrochemical etching in galvanostatic mode. Changes in the surface morphology of the studied porous GaAs layers obtained on irradiated substrates are presented. In the Raman spectra, phonon bands of LO and TO modes are observed in the frequency range of 145 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 150 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. The TO/LO ratio increases with increasing wafer irradiation dose. Porous GaAs samples exhibit phonon peaks of other compounds Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and amorphous GaAs. The change in the intensity of the Raman spectrum peaks is determined by the irradiation dose of the wafers. With increasing irradiation dose to wafers, the intensity of the maximum photoluminescence peak for porous layers decreases. From the spectral dependences of photoluminescence, a change in the size of GaAs nanocrystallites was obtained with increasing irradiation dose from 14.5 to 10 nm (860 nm region) and about 3–4 nm (for the 630 nm region).

articleTitle: The Electron Sources for Powerful X-Ray Emission in Modern Computed Tomography Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Two designs of the high-power X-ray emitter electron sources are proposed to replace existing foreign analogues in modern computed tomography devices.

articleTitle: Circuitry Methods for Compensating Parasitic Capacitances of SiGe and CMOS SOI Transistors in High-Temperature Operational Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: High-temperature technologies for the production of analog microcircuits, including SiGe and SOI, impose a number of restrictions on the numerical values of the capacitance’s transistors used and, as a consequence, the operating frequency range of devices this class. The article discusses circuitry methods that provide for CMOS and BJT transistors an electronic circuit to minimize the influence of parasitic capacitances on the high-frequency cutoff of the voltage gain operational amplifiers and the frequency dependence of the common mode rejection ratio of input differential stages. As an example, the results of simulation in the Cadence environment of CMOS operational amplifiers using XB06 and TSMC processes transistor models are presented to show the effectiveness of the proposed circuit solutions.

articleTitle: Spin Pumping by Magnetostatic Surface Waves in YIG(100)/Pt Microstructures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The spin pumping by traveling magnetostatic surface waves (MSSW) in two YIG/Pt structures corresponding to the cases of MSSWpropagation along the [100] direction (hard axis of magnetization) and [110] direction(easy axis of magnetization) has been studied using the inverse spin Hall effect (ISHE). It is shown that the cubic anisotropy field does not change the character of the frequency dependences of the electromotive force U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ISHE</inf>(f), but for the [110] direction it leads to an increase in the signal U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ISHE</inf> (f) and an upward shift in frequency by 410 MHz relative to the case of magnetization along the «hard» axis.

articleTitle: Using DLP 3-D Printing for Additive Manufacturing of Millimeter-Band Waveguides and Slow-Wave Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Development of upper-millimeter or sub-THz radiation sources is of great importance for numerous applications in communications, radar, spectroscopy, etc. For fabrication of miniaturized electromagnetic components, novel precise, rapid, and cost-effective technologies are required. In this paper, we present the results of microfabrication of millimeter-band electromagnetic structures using digital-light-processing (DLP) 3-D printing and subsequent metallization by magnetron sputtering. V-band and W-band rectangular waveguides were fabricated, as well as more complicated periodic grating slow-wave structures. Characterization of the fabricated structures was performed by using surface morphology studies and scanning electron microscopy. Cold-test electromagnetic measurements reveal good transmission properties of the fabricated structures.

articleTitle: Design and Research of a 24 GHz Range Data Transmission System Based on the Use of Doppler Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Doppler sensors are well known, the theory about them has been developed and many years of use have proven the effectiveness of such devices. At the same time, it is possible to utilize such sensors in a non-traditional way, which could allow expanding the range of their usage, creating new technologies and projects. This paper is devoted to one of such cases – the creation of a digital information transmission system consisting of two Doppler sensors performing in the 24 GHz band. The article describes the design procedure, provides recommendations for using such a system, and presents the results of the study of the system key parameters.

articleTitle: Structure-Logic Circuits of Self-Compensation Sub-Circuits of CMOS Transistor’s (Si-SOI, GaN, GaAs, SiC) Parasitic Capacitances in High-Impedance Unit of High-Temperature Transimpedance and Operational Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Possible variants of the constructing compensation sub-circuits for output CMOS transistor’s gate-to-drain capacitance in active loads and reference current sources in high-temperature broadband amplifiers are considered. The basic circuits of operational (Op-Amp) and transimpedance (TIA) amplifiers with their self-compensation, ensuring an increase in their upper cut-off frequency, are presented. These circuits differ from each other in the channels for transmitting small AC currents through the parasitic drain-gate capacitances of CMOS transistors using Si-SOI, GaN, GaAs, SiC technical processes. These circuits differ in the channels used to carry small AC currents through the parasitic drain-gate capacitances of CMOS transistors using Si-SOI, GaN, GaAs, SiC technology processes. As an example, the equations for the transfer function of one of the options for constructing broadband amplifiers are obtained.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Algorithms for Microscopy Classification of Nanocomposites Using a Federated Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The work solves the problem of classifying nanocomposites using computer vision technology in conditions where microscopy images obtained for training cannot be used centrally for training for various confidentiality reasons. To solve this problem, a computer vision system is implemented and an approach based on federated machine learning is presented, allowing the system to be trained locally considering data confidentiality criteria. The computer vision system is based on a modified convolutional neural network. A horizontal federated machine learning architecture is used to ensure data privacy. A comparison was made of this system with classical machine learning methods. The accuracy of the model was 93.4% according to the accuracy metric.

articleTitle: Problems of Increasing the Accuracy of Integrated Methods for Measuring Inertial Modules and Methods for Obtaining Navigation Measurement Information Based on MEMS Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article discusses the problems of accuracy and reliability of the use of integrated navigation systems. Integrated navigation systems are complex systems that combine data from various navigation sensors, such as GPS, inertial measurement units (IMU), odometers and others. The focus is on the analysis of factors affecting the accuracy and reliability of integrated navigation systems, including measurement errors, data filtering and fusion algorithms, and calibration and error compensation methods. The results of experimental studies and modeling are presented, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Thermal Model of Silicon-Carbide and Gallium-Nitride High-Temperature Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Thermal models of high-temperature integrated circuits (ICs) on wide-gap semiconductors (silicon-carbide and gallium-nitride) are considered. The “chip-to-environment” thermal-resistance is calculated for one of the ICs designs. The chip overheating temperatures of silicon-carbide (SiC) and gallium-nitride (GaN) ICs were determined taking into account the dependence of the thermal conductivity coefficients of SiC and GaN on temperature. For two self-heating power levels (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>=1 W, P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>=100 mW), it is shown that the thermal-resistance of the chip increases with increasing temperature. The obtained research results presented in the article are recommended for use in the design of high-temperature integrated circuits based on wide-gap semiconductors.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Image Processing in the Mining Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The authors of this paper propose to consider the development of methods and algorithms for digital image processing in the mining industry:•methods and algorithms for image contrast;•methods and algorithms for digital image filtering;•methods and algorithms for image segmentation;•methods and algorithms for object recognition.These methods are considered in relation to image forming devices.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Correlation Coefficient Based Trackers for Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Mode tracking is a challenging task when using characteristic mode analysis in a frequency range. In this paper, two mode tracking algorithms based on the correlation coefficient of eigenvectors of adjacent frequencies are presented. Based on them, a MATLAB code is developed to analyze the dipole structure in the frequency range of 0.1–1 GHz. The results obtained with these algorithms are verified by comparison with those obtained in previous publications. By comparing the considered algorithms with each other, no significant difference in the accuracy of mode tracking is found. The performance of each algorithm is reported.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Compact Gyrotron with an Axis-Encircling Beam for Spectroscopic Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A new version of a compact gyrotron with an axis-encircling beam is discussed. This gyrotron has an azimuthally asymmetric electron gun, which forms an axis-encircling helical electron beam (HEB). Non-adiabatic effects are not used to form a HEB in a compact gyrotron in contrast to a conventional gyrotron with an axis-encircling beam. However, there is no azimuthal symmetry of the system electrodes. The power of the formed HEB is relatively low, but sufficient for spectroscopic applications. This gyrotron modification can be used with “budget” cryogen free magnet with a small bore. An example of a compact gyrotron with a radiation frequency of 395 GHz is presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Output Dual-Frequency Sector Cavity of a Klystron-Type Multibeam Device with Short-Circuited Rod Walls
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of a study on the possibility of creating klystron-type sector cavities with walls made of short-circuited metal rods. The study was conducted using three-dimensional electromagnetic modeling, and the main electrodynamic parameters were calculated. These parameters include the resonant frequency, intrinsic quality factor, characteristic impedance, interaction coefficient, and active component of electronic conductivity.

articleTitle: Silicon Crystallization on a Flexible Substrate Using Refractory Metals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of the study of silicon crystallization on flexible polyimide substrates. Crystallization was carried out by the method of metal-induced laser-stimulated crystallization. A feature of this work is the use of refractory metals such as molybdenum and tungsten as an absorbing layer. An infrared pulsed laser is used for crystallization. To determine the quality of crystallization, the structure of silicon was studied by Raman scattering.

articleTitle: Development of a Super-Powerful 20 MW Pulsed S-band Klystron
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report discusses the design challenges and issues of creating a highly powerful klystron for powering a linear electron accelerator in a synchrotron radiation source. It presents the results of calculations for the electrodynamic, electron-optic systems, and the klystron interaction cavity. The test results from the first prototype are also shown.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Calculations in Relation to the Problem of Designing New Nanocomposite Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, the application of evolutionary modeling for the design of new nanocomposite materials with the required properties is considered. A block diagram of a software package including a modified genetic algorithm is proposed. A numerical experiment was performed to find the optimal structure and composition of a nanocomposite material with the required dielectric constant.

articleTitle: Study of Transformation of Rotational Motion of Electrons into Translational Motion in a Cyclotron-Wave Converter of Microwave Power into DC Power
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Due to modern trends in the use of microwave radiation for energy transfer systems, a new task has emerged - the creation of powerful devices that carry out efficient conversion of large levels of microwave energy into DC energy. Vacuum devices utilising the phenomenon of cyclotron resonance in electron flow may be the most promising for these purposes. The cyclotron-wave converter (CWC) is resistant to overloads in high-frequency and low-frequency circuits, and has high radiation resistance. In this paper, microwave to dc power converters are considered. The results of the study of an experimental mock-up of a cyclotron converter are given.

articleTitle: Development of EOS for a C-Band Klystron with Continuous Output with a Capacity of at Least 200 kW
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of designing an electron-optical system (EOS) with a cylindrical cathode in an electron gun in the magnetic field of a solenoid with a given distribution of the longitudinal component of magnetic induction are presented. The found variants of the geometries of the cylindrical cathode and the focusing electrode ensure the transportation of the electron flux in the magnetic field of the solenoid throughout the interaction space.

articleTitle: Sensor and Device for Non-Contact Temperature Measurement of Structural Elements of Micro- and Radioelectronics Products
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the structural scheme and describes the principle of operation of a temperature sensor with the transmission of measurement information by means of optical radiation. The sensor is realized according to the scheme of multivibrator on a Schmitt trigger with a thermistor in the feedback circuit, the oscillation frequency of which depends on the temperature. The photodetector designed to measure the parameters of the optical signal of the sensor is described. The results of measurements of the conversion function and calibration characteristic of the sensor are given, the dependence of the sensor sensitivity on temperature in the range from 25 to 100 °C is determined. The developed sensor can be used as an integrated means of diagnostics of thermal parameters of design elements of micro- and radioelectronics products both at the stage of prototype production and during operation.

articleTitle: On the Influence of Self-Generated Magnetic Field on Electron Beams Transport in High-Power Pulse Klystrons
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: It is demonstrated that in short-pulse vacuum devices self-generated magnetic field of electron beams is effectively shielded by copper envelope and doesn’t influence beams transport with the exception of electron gun area. In a gun of high-current multibeam klystron electron beams are declined to common axis of the device due to collective self-magnetic field. A technique of current intercept determination is considered which is based on measurement of self-magnetic field.

articleTitle: Specifics of Operation and Maintenance of Microwave Defrosters in Russia
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper shows the current state of development of microwave food defrosting in Russia. The market analysis of microwave defrosting equipment is carried out and the current directions of its development after 2022 are described. Numerous studies of the tunnel multi-section microwave defrosters condition have been carried out. The main problems arising during the operation and maintenance of microwave defrosters are identified. It is shown that domestic manufacturers can successfully replace imported main components of foreign microwave defrosting equipment. The results of the successful replacement of imported high-power industrial magnetrons with microwave power up to 75 kW at a frequency of 915 MHz with a similar device M-177 manufactured by JSC ‘NPP ‘Magratep’ are presented. A solution to the problem of temporary degradation of ferrite circulators has been proposed to extend the service life of magnetrons.

articleTitle: Computer Model of a Microstrip U-Shaped Filter for Virtual Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article considers modeling of a microstrip filter on U-shaped resonators. Electrodynamic analysis and synthesis of the three-section filter on U-shaped resonators are carried out. The characteristics of the filter are investigated, its prototype is developed and compared with the experimental model. The developed model of the microstrip filter is integrated in the virtual laboratory.

articleTitle: SiC JFET Template Model for Extremely High-Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper proposes a compact model of a silicon-carbide (SiC) field-effect transistor with control p-n junction (JFET) whose parameters are determined by measurements. The model is developed using the template modeling method, in which constant parameters of the model are replaced by fractional-rational functions (Padé approximation), allowing to describe more accurately the physical processes in the electronic component without violating the nature of their change. The demonstrated SiC JFET model is formulated as a function of both the fundamental process parameters that control the electrical behavior of the device (e.g., threshold voltage) and the geometric layout parameters associated with the device (e.g., device length and width), providing a rational basis for statistical modeling of process variation effects.

articleTitle: Different Diode Based Nonlinear Circuits for Pulse Activity Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The objective of this study is to compare two hardware implementations of a nonlinear neuron-like generator, based on RLC-circuit, operational amplifier and various number of diodes. The first circuit was a simplified version of the previously published FitzHugh–Nagumo circuit. The second one was modified using additional diode in the operational amplifier subcircuit. We discovered that the first one demonstrates only a quasi-linear mode, when the second one can work in two different modes: quasi-linear and strongly nonlinear pulse regimes. We experimentally conducted a simple partial bifurcation analysis to investigate the mechanisms of oscillation nucleation within the circuit. Our findings indicate that adding a diode into the operational amplifier subcircuit significantly improves the circuit ability to generate pulses.

articleTitle: Modernization of an Electron-Optical System with a Ring Cathode in a TWT with Low Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the modernization of an electronoptical system (EOS) with a ring cathode in an electron gun and a magnetic periodic focusing system (MPFS) from the third spatial harmonic of the magnetic field are presented. The configuration of electron gun electrodes with low-voltage gridless control of the beam current, which forms an electron flow with a small spread of transverse components of electron velocities, as well as the distribution of the magnetic field in the MPPS with the third spatial harmonic, ensured the transportation of the electron flow in an extended flight channel with a high level of current flow in the operating mode.

articleTitle: Obtaining Nano-Structural Thin Compounds Formed by Microwave Plasma
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Microwave plasma technology is a cutting-edge method for synthesizing nanostructural thin compounds. This technique uses microwave radiation to generate plasma, which in turn enables the deposition of thin films with high precision and control. The article provides an overview of the process, key features and advantages, and the practical application of microwave plasma for the synthesis of nanostructural thin compounds.

articleTitle: Low-Voltage Electron-Optical System for W-band TWT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The design of electron-optical system is described for a low-voltage multibeam TWT with an accelerating voltage 2.5 kV, intended for operation in the W-band in a single-beam or multibeam device

articleTitle: Application of the Least Squares Method in Calculations of Radiation Utilization Factors for Industrial Video Cameras Based on Large-Format CMOS Matrices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper considers the application of the least-squares method to calculate the polynomial approximation coefficients of the relative spectral sensitivity curves of CMOS sensors and the human eye. The obtained polynomials were used for calculations of radiation utilization coefficients. The used algorithms showed their efficiency and speed in this subject area and allowed to calculate the technical characteristics of the designed video surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Operation of a Mobile High-Speed Microwave Sterilizer in Hike and Field Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The factors affecting the operating mode of microwave setups, including microwave sterilizers, are considered. Options for constructing autonomous power supply systems for mobile microwave sterilizers in field and hike conditions are proposed.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Industrial Manipulator Control Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A mathematical apparatus for forming motion trajectories of an industrial manipulator when performing technological operations has been developed. Algorithms for the mathematical apparatus are created, which are integrated into a simulation model. A kinematic diagram of a six-tree manipulator is drawn up for conducting research on motion trajectory planning. Algorithms for solving the forward and inverse problem of kinematics and motion planning of the manipulator are derived. The proposed algorithms are interpreted in program form in C# language. The results of the study were visualized in an environment for 3D viewing with the possibility of adjusting the input characteristics of the simulation model. The obtained software solution allowed to simulate the motion trajectory of the manipulator links with an accuracy from 0.1° to 1° at a calculation time of ≈15.62 milliseconds.

articleTitle: A Method for Reducing the Dynamic Error of Power Frequency Measurement for the Case of Quadrature Demodulation Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Currently, the quadrature demodulation method is widely used to measure the frequency of the power grid in conditions of both sinusoidal and polyharmonic input signals. Along with the signal phase increment method, this approach is the most common in practice and widely studied in the theoretical field. One of the problems of this method is the presence of a significant dynamic error caused by transients in the output filter of the demodulator. The modification proposed in this article is intended to reduce this problem by using two demodulators in parallel. The error of frequency measurement when using a demodulator is considered. The basic idea of the applied modification is analytically shown and its effect on the final error of frequency measurement is obtained. The variants of the modified demodulator construction are considered, their advantages and disadvantages are indicated. The influence of the initial phase of the demodulator reference signals on the frequency measurement error is considered. The estimation of the final error of frequency measurement using this technique has been performed, and an analytical expression for its evaluation has been obtained. The measurement of the RMS and the initial phase of this technique is considered. The problems that arise when performing such a measurement are identified and ways to solve them are outlined. With the help of Matlab and Simulink software packages, simulation models were built to evaluate the correctness of the obtained analytical expressions.

articleTitle: Calibration of Piezoresistive Pressure Sensors in a Wide Temperature Range
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Piezoresistive pressure sensors (PPS) are widely used in various microelectronic devices applied in modern technologies. The performance of these sensors are highly dependent on the ambient temperature. Unfortunately, known methods of PPS calibration do not allow measuring pressure with the required accuracy in the wide temperature range typical, for instance, in aviation from −60 to 140 °C. In this paper, a conventional approach is used, when the dependence of the output voltage on pressure is represented using a polynomial of a relatively low order, and the dependences of the coefficients of this polynomial on temperature are specified by the cubic splines. The paper describes in detail the identification method of the polynomial model under consideration and obtains expressions for correcting the readings of the pressure gauge during pressure measurements in wide temperature ranges, when the temperature dependence model is specified using cubic splines. The results of experimental studies of specific pressure sensors are presented.

articleTitle: Semi-Markov Telecommunication Networks Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper proposes a semi-Markov model of telecommunication network (TCN). The variant of dynamic traffic adaptive control of queuing system as a special case of TCN is considered. The main purpose of control is to minimize the average cost per unit of time to service the incoming flow of information (packets). This takes into account the different bandwidth of the channels, the processing speed of information in the channel and the information capacity of the buffers. The approach to the organization of dynamic control taking into account noise immunity (information reliability) and information security is discussed.
